name: Naming Checker
description: Checks file names, sheet numbers and names, view names and level/grid names against a naming convention you provide (a pattern of named fields with allowed values per field). Read-only; it does not ship or assume any standard or national code list.
author: AEC Model Bridge

convention.description: Your naming convention: {"pattern": "{project}-{originator}-{number}", "fields": {"project": {"allowed": ["PRJ1"]}, "number": {"regex": "[0-9]{4}"}}}. To use different patterns for different kinds of names, give {"by_kind": {"file_names": {...}, "level_names": {...}}} instead.

convention_file.description: Name of a bundled example convention (see list_example_conventions) or a path to a convention JSON file inside the workspace. Used only when 'convention' is not given.

names.description: The names to check, as lists under any of: file_names, sheet_numbers, sheet_names, view_names, level_names, grid_names. Example: {"file_names": ["PRJ1-ABC-ZZ-00-M3-A-0001"]}.

snapshot_id.description: Optional saved snapshot to read sheets, views, levels, grids and the document title from, in addition to any names given.

kinds.description: Optional: only check these kinds (file_names, sheet_numbers, sheet_names, view_names, level_names, grid_names). Default is every kind that has names and a convention.
